static_traits.name: Li Hang
static_traits.occupation: Not disclosed; Work performance affected by depression
static_traits.family_status: Not mentioned family structure; relationships with family affected due to Avoids socializing
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends but not yet opened up to them, Tense relationships with friends due to Avoids socializing
static_traits.medical_history: Previously experienced depressive episodes during high-pressure periods, but never lasting this long; has not yet received psychotherapy; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: High cooperation, clear and coherent expression; slightly Anxious at first but hopeful; able to identify and describe one's own negative thinking patterns

basic_info.main_problem: I feel I like Being alone, because I am severely depressed, and believe I will never recover.
basic_info.core_demands: I want to find better ways to manage these feelings. I am tired of them controlling my life and affecting my Work and Interpersonal relationships; I just want to find my old self again.
growth_experiences: Experienced a period of extreme stress a few years ago, during which the depression began and gradually worsened; believes past trauma and ongoing daily stress together contributed to the current depression.
Previously also experienced depressive episodes during high-pressure stages, but never lasting this long; never received any psychotherapy or Intervention before; no significant physical illness.

special_situations.event: Being alone at night (especially when alone)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I feel pain and despair when Being alone at night, it means I will never get better
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Choosing isolation, Reduced socializing to try to avoid triggering emotions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never recover, the future has no hope

special_situations.event: After experiencing a highly stressful workday
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If Work performance is affected by depression, it shows I have been completely controlled by depression, unable to change
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: After work, avoids interacting with friends and family, stays alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My Work will only get worse, I will not improve

special_situations.event: When thinking about past trauma and ongoing daily stress
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I experienced trauma and still have stress now, it means I cannot possibly Recovery
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Relies on distraction and self-help books for temporary relief
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am destined to be trapped by depression

special_situations.event: When considering confiding in friends or accepting social invitations
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I tell friends about my problems, it will burden them, I should not trouble others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding opening up to friends, refusing or Reduced socializing

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and supported and to recover from depression
core_conflict.fear: Fearing burdening others, being rejected or judged
defense_goal: Reducing Anxiety and avoiding burdening others by staying distant and Being alone
Controls emotional fluctuations through rationalization and self-restriction

object_relations.self_representation: A Loneliness and hopeless trapped person
object_relations.object_representation: Others are people who may be dragged down by me and may reject me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing whether to ask friends for help or receiving social invitations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing that expressing needs to others will burden them and may invite rejection or judgment
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone polite but avoidant, repeatedly emphasizing 'not wanting to trouble others', postponing or declining interaction in a tactful way.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When nighttime emotions worsen and the counselor invites them to identify and express current emotions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing strong emotional experiences as dangerous or hard to bear, worrying about losing control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Describes experiences in rational, generalized language, reducing emotional coloring, avoiding going into the level of concrete feelings.

manifestations: Long-term preference for Being alone and Avoids socializing
Depression and hopelessness strongest on nights of Being alone
Not yet opening up to friends about troubles, worrying about becoming a burden
Repeatedly experiencing the belief 'I will never recover'
outcomes: Declining motivation and functioning (Work performance impaired, Sleep and self-care are affected)

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: When talking about help-seeking in counseling, repeatedly expressing 'should not trouble others', suppressing the help-seeking urge back into oneself and choosing Being alone
Reduced socializing rather than seeking support

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: When discussing opening up to friends, over-restrains self for fear of burdening others

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Tending to use distraction and self-help books to avoid directly experiencing painful emotions
Distracts attention through self-isolation when emotions run high at night

exception_events.target_problem: When Being alone at night, the client typically falls into hopelessness and chooses isolation, Low mood hard to ease.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once when spending time with a close friend, emotions became lighter, did not fall into the usual hopelessness, able to engage in the present interaction.
exception_events.reason: Different support: having trustworthy companionship and emotional support, shifting attention from negative thinking to present interaction.

exception_events.target_problem: When Work stress increases or Being alone, the client typically repeatedly thinks catastrophically 'I will never get better', leading to further worsening emotions.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once when focusing on one's own hobbies, briefly experienced lighter emotions, thinking no longer persistently catastrophic.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: immersively participating in hobby activities, bringing focus and pleasure; different situation: no high-pressure situation at present.

positive_force: Has a few trustworthy friends who can provide support
Able to focus and engage in hobbies, with brief improvement in mood
Clear motivation to seek help, positive attitude, willing to try practicing
Able to identify and describe one's own negative thinking patterns (such as catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking)
negative_force: Strong cognitive patterns of catastrophizing, predicting the future, overgeneralization, black-and-white
Social avoidance and self-isolation, not yet opening up to friends
Worsened emotions and rumination when Being alone at night
Viewing seeking help as 'troubling others', excessive self-restriction
Impaired work performance, decline in sleep and self-care

antecedent: Receiving social invitations or thinking about confiding in friends
After experiencing a highly stressful workday
target_behavior.core_reason: Based on the core belief 'I will never get better' and the rule 'cannot trouble others', catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking driving avoidance to reduce short-term Anxiety
target_behavior.function: Escaping unwelcome stimuli (negative emotions, others' evaluations and being seen as a burden), gaining short-term psychological security
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension, worsened Loneliness, depression maintained or worsened, insufficient use of support resources

target_behavior.behavior: Nighttime rumination and despairing thoughts (such as 'I will never recover')
antecedent: Recalling past trauma and daily stress
target_behavior.core_reason: Driven by cognitive patterns such as catastrophizing, predicting the future and overgeneralization, treating current pain as a permanent state
target_behavior.function: Trying to gain certainty through thought control and rehearsing the future, but actually Reinforcing hopelessness
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep impaired, worsened Low mood, next-day functioning declining (attention and Work performance impaired)
